precision.target: Selective affine Q8/group64; exact-zero symmetric encoding
precision.normalization: FP32 accumulation and scale multiplication, cast back to activation dtype

rate_definition: Generated tokens divided by full native decode duration; includes first token and any calibration, excludes preparation, admission, prefill and tool execution.
warmup: Native comparisons retain and exclude the first 256-token repetition per prompt/width. Final HTTP comparisons retain and exclude the first attempt per prompt/configuration.

q8-fused-quality-vs-bf16.limitation: Bounded text regression diagnostic; coding, vision, and general quality require separate evidence.

q8-fused-quality-vs-retained-q8.limitation: Bounded text regression diagnostic; coding, vision, and general quality require separate evidence.

limitations: Two deterministic greedy prompts are not a general task benchmark.
Sequential variants; GPU frequency is not fixed and thermal states are retained.
Fused normalization can change greedy continuations; no universal bit-equivalence claim.
Fixed English-text likelihood diagnostic reused during development; not an independent general-quality estimate.
Earlier scheduling sweep excluded for overlapping external GPU tests.
Content and likelihood fixtures were reused during development and selection.
Selected normalization-free configuration does not claim the fused-normalization likelihood result as a new quality improvement.
Sequential reference/candidate/reference; GPU clocks are not fixed and only two measured samples per prompt/configuration.

selected_configuration.status: Experimental; original normalization retained after content-quality regression in fused normalization combination.

production_provenance.compiler_configuration: Production Release without DEBUG test hooks
production_provenance.rule: First attempt per prompt is warmup. Collect first two later resource-qualified requests; exclude only monitored compilation, other compute, pressure or thermal violations. No timing-based exclusion. Three seconds of quiet resources precede each attempt.
production_provenance.changes_since_initial_policy: Lazy cost calibration only for sustained low acceptance; signed-index guard with native fallback. Q8 shader math unchanged.

selected_http.rule: First attempt per prompt/configuration is warmup; retain first two later resource-qualified requests. No timing-based exclusions. Reference/candidate/reference use one Release binary.

quality.rejection_reason: Two additional requested JSON-shape instruction misses: sort and stable-duplicate. Do not infer general accuracy percentages from this small reused fixture set.

real_checkpoint_low_acceptance.purpose: Exercise real-checkpoint lazy calibration under forced low-acceptance threshold; no throughput claim.
real_checkpoint_low_acceptance.normalization: Fused normalization in a correctness-only core-calibration run; not the selected configuration and not timing evidence.

performance.queue_wait: Not separately instrumented; sequential client and sampled queue depth zero
Not separately instrumented; sequential client and sampled queue depth zero

full_gate.limitation: Protected run-record access while device locked; no Glimmer failures. File protection unchanged.

desktop.limitation: Mac locked. Prior Q8 app outcomes qualify the reference, not changed inference math or policy.

configuration.status: Experimental opt-in; benchmark and SDK/coding qualification candidate. Desktop repeat and unlocked full gate still required.
